items.title: Hollard refreshes brand positioning around greater certainty - Moonstone Information Refinery
items.raw_summary: Hollard has introduced a refreshed brand positioning, “Hollard. Be More Sure”, building on its “Insure Your Unsure” campaign and placing greater emphasis on helping customers to navigate uncertainty. Announced on 8 October 2026, the positioning reflects the group’s view that individuals and businesses need to understand and manage risks in an increasingly complex environment. Hollard offers short-term insurance, life insurance, and investment products. Through Hollard International, the group operates in 10 African markets: South Africa, Botswana, Ghana, Lesotho, Mozambique, Namibia, Zambia, Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda. Hazel Chimhandamba (pictured), Hollard’s chief marketing officer, said the new positioning was based on the universal need for greater certainty when making decisions about personal finances, careers, and business. “We’ve never believed in catastrophising insurance because of the meaningful role it plays in driving societal impact. Instead, we acknowledge that the world is changing faster than ever, bringing new opportunities, challenges, and risks,” she said.
items.title_pt: Hollard reposiciona marca focando em maior segurança e certeza
items.summary_pt: Reposicionamento estratégico que evolui mensagem anterior e clarifica proposta de valor em mercado incerto.
